tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Save a new contact. Copy the name word for word and the number digit for digit; never invent or complete them.

name.description: Full name of the contact, copied word for word.

phone.description: The phone number exactly as given; include only when stated.

email.description: The email address; include only when stated.

merchant.description: The store or vendor copied word for word; include only when named.
